test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

How simple for the English __businesman__ to word a cable that would be __intelligible__ to Italian, Turkish and Chinese __firms__? If __statesmen__ could discuss directly and accurately the problems.
solution:
The correct answer is** "businesman". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The spelling error is found in **"businesman", **which is misspelled.
 
• The correct spelling should be **"businessman", **with double **'s' **in the middle of the word.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Statesmen:** This option is correctly spelled.

 
 
• A statesman is a skilled, experienced, and respected political leader or figure.
 
 
 
• **Intelligible: **This option is also correctly spelled.
 
 
• It means something that is clear enough to be understood, comprehensible.
 
 
 
• **Firms: **This is the correct spelling for the plural form of **"firm", **indicating businesses or companies.
 
 
• This option doesn't contain any spelling error.
